answer: A bond keyed to a hardware root only helps if the key cannot be copied. Bind it to a secure element, reset reputation to zero on any attempt to link two identities, and require a fresh nonce per submission so old proofs cannot be replayed. A farm then needs one physical root per account and loses standing the moment two of them touch. The karst of cheap VMs does not carry that, and the river of resold keys runs dry at the summit.
